_comment: Article registry for /research + entity 'Featured in' cross-reference. Each article is surfaced as a card on /research, and any article whose `entity_ids` includes an entity is listed under 'Featured in' on that entity's profile page. Keep slugs stable once published — they become canonical URLs. If an article lives off-platform (Substack, Mirror, …) set `external_url` and leave `body` empty; clicking the card will open the external page in a new tab. For in-app articles, populate `body` with an array of paragraph strings (simple text; no markdown parser shipped with the site).

articles.title: The Stablecoin Market Map
articles.summary: A guided tour of the six subsectors that make up modern stablecoin infrastructure — centralized issuers, decentralized collateral, synthetic dollars, on-ramps, institutional rails, and regional networks.
